name: Carepatron AI Scribe
description: Carepatron is an all-in-one practice management platform with built-in AI scribe included on all plans—including the free tier. Pricing: Free ($0 with AI scribe + 1GB storage), Plus $15.50/mo (unlimited AI + storage), Advanced $19.50/mo (team controls + white labeling). The AI Charting Assistant transcribes telehealth sessions or dictation and generates structured notes using Smart Prompts for summarization, client goals, and referral letters. HIPAA, GDPR, and PIPEDA compliant—no transcript data used for AI training. Best value proposition: free AI scribe for solo practitioners who need basic practice management. Strongest competitor to SimplePractice and TherapyNotes for mental health clinicians who want AI included without add-on fees.

faqs.q: How much does Carepatron AI scribe cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Carepatron includes AI scribe on all plans: Free ($0/mo with capped tokens), Plus ($15.50/mo unlimited AI), Advanced ($19.50/mo with team controls). No separate AI add-on fees.

faqs.q: Is Carepatron AI scribe HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes. Carepatron is HIPAA, GDPR, and PIPEDA compliant with BAA available. Transcript data is never used for AI model training.

faqs.q: Does Carepatron have a free plan with AI scribe?
faqs.a: Yes. The Free tier includes AI scribe (with monthly token cap), unlimited clients, telehealth, client portal, and automated payments. 1GB storage limit. Upgrade to Plus ($15.50/mo) for unlimited AI.

faqs.q: Carepatron vs SimplePractice: which is better for AI documentation?
faqs.a: Carepatron includes AI scribe free on all plans. SimplePractice charges extra for its Note Taker ($15/mo add-on on top of base plans $39-59/mo). For budget-conscious practices, Carepatron's free AI scribe is more cost-effective.

faqs.q: Is Carepatron good for mental health therapists?
faqs.a: Yes, for therapists wanting a simple all-in-one platform. However, for therapy-specific templates (CBT/DBT/IFS) and detailed session analysis, Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) offer more specialized features.
